layer_3_action.subject: Ichthyosaurus communis
layer_3_action.action: The Ichthyosaurus is positioned in the center, banking gracefully to the right.

companions.description: A massive 2-foot wide coiled ammonite shell with deep ridges and colorful clay patterns, floating in the upper left background.
A small school of three darting, squid-like creatures with visible bullet-shaped internal guards, scattered in the mid-ground.
A nautilus relative with a smooth, pearlescent coiled shell and small reaching tentacles, hovering near the bottom right.

text_overlay.style: Bright red, 3D extruded clay-style lettering, mixed case, playful sans-serif font.

visual_logic.water: Deep indigo blue with shimmering vertical 'god-rays' illuminating the floating 'marine snow' particulates.
visual_logic.lighting: Soft studio lighting with ambient occlusion to emphasize the 'handmade' clay textures of the shells and skin.
